title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode11 Monkey Bars and Meteor Showers

meta.Episode: Episode11 — Monkey Bars and Meteor Showers

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder when will Ichika and Saki come back?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're impatient to see them, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka! I didn't notice you were there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I've been watching you milling around restlessly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, you should have said something instead of spying on me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I, too, hope that they discover their true feelings soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. But I'm afraid they're not ready to face them yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe here they can find the courage.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I hope so.
Oh? I hear two pairs of footsteps running towards us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miku! Luka! Sorry for barging in! We have to master this song so that Shiho will join our band!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry if we're asking too much, but this is our chance to have Shiho join! Could you please help us practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. So your friend is considering joining your band after all?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can always count on our help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That phrasing was really good.
Can we try it again?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Once again from the top!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Luka, I don't know what sort of vibe this melody should have. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... How about playing it this way?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, when did it get so late?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is it late? Gosh, you're right! I was so absorbed, I didn't notice the time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's always sunset in this world, so it feels as if time is standing still.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The scenery is also formed from your feelings. That's why it's that melancholy, lonesome time of the day here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Say, isn't this song kinda difficult?
You can tell Shiho chose it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But don't you think she picked it because she really hopes you'll take this whole band thing seriously?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that feeling too! And the more I play it, the more confident I get!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On a different note... Ichi, I came up with this tune while we were practicing. Want to hear it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: An original tune? Sure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Yay! I'll play it now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh, that's really neat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You think so? Yay! You used to write song lyrics at one point, remember? Since then I've been composing little bits in my head every now and then!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, yeah. I had that phase, but I stopped writing a while back. But, I'll be happy to listen to any of your creations!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! By the way, did you notice this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is a...star map?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. There's another one drawn on the blackboard, as if the class was preparing for a stargazing trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd love to go stargazing myself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can, if you go to the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's still early in the evening...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
SEKAI is a world created from your feelings.
Give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Look at that! I don't think I've ever seen the night sky so clear!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But how is this possible? The sun was setting only a moment ago!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born from your thoughts and feelings, so the form it takes is based on that, too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our feelings, huh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, do you remember when all four of us were stargazing together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I do! We climbed the jungle gym and looked out for shooting stars!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which constellation was it over? Cancer?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Leo. We were watching the Leonids.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, right. That one. Hona tried so hard to teach us, remember?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, she's always been interested in them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Shiho said none of Honami's lectures stuck in her mind. Not that I can really remember which is which, either.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I do, though. Honami repeated the names over and over, and she actually got upset with Shiho for not remembering any of them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah! Shiho and I weren't prepared for Honami's angry side, so we panicked and for once paid attention to the star map. I can't believe it was so long ago!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well... In a few days we're meeting up with Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have to play that song perfectly, so that she'll join us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe one day we'll all stargaze together again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope so!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (With Saki beside me, I'm hopeful that we can all be together again, just like before.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I really want to be friends with Shiho again. I'll put everything I've got into playing that song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We can do this, Saki.
A few days later
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, we're ready!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think this needs explaining, but if you mess up even just a bit, you can forget about me joining you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're aware of that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good. Let's head over to the studio.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Isn't that...Shiho? She's with Saki and Ichika?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wonder where they're going. Maybe they patched things up.)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: What's the hold up, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! I'm coming!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm happy for them, if they really made up. It's nice that they can be friends again.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's for the best...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But why did seeing them together make me feel so lonely?)
